known_gaps.question: How do I remove or fade only the wall that is currently blocking/occluding the player (DOTA-style depth fade of occluded geometry)?
known_gaps.why: No doc covers runtime depth-based fading of occluding world geometry. known_gaps.question: Where are CS2 runtime wall/visibility 'occluders' (the invisible-wall kind the user meant) documented?
known_gaps.why: The corpus only knows two unrelated meanings. Searches: 'occluder'(total 3) top hit r_csgo_sky_occluder is a SKYBOX convar, plus server:prop_static and the Hammer visibility doc; 'vis occluder'(2), 'visblocker'(1 -> Hammer visibility doc), 'visibility occluder wall'(0), 'occluder' deadlock(1 -> Hammer visibility doc). All hits are map-compile-time precomputed VIS, not a runtime per-wall visibility/occlusion feature.
